title: ATE Mechanical Engineer (Contractor)
description:
ATE Mechanical Engineer

As a ATE Mechanical Engineer at Lunar, you will be responsible for the full product development lifecycle of mechanical systems within our revolutionary home energy products. We are looking for people who are passionate about a more sustainable future and want to make that vision a reality. An ideal candidate is excited and ready to collaborate closely with a small, dedicated team. Engineers at Lunar are hands-on and involved in a wide range of facets of the product, from applying fundamental physical principles in design to working with high-volume production suppliers.

Lunar Energy was founded to transition homes to 100% clean energy—making our electricity greener, our air cleaner and our energy more safe, secure and reliable for all. We’re a fast-growing, global company building the world’s best clean energy products to electrify all homes and connect communities to form clean, resilient virtual power plants.

On a given day at Lunar, you’ll likely…

  • Work back and forth with collaborators across the company to continuously refine and improve our understanding of how our products can create the greatest impact, get to market quickly, and operate reliably for our customers
  • Brainstorm and evaluate new solutions, weigh pros and cons, and narrow down options
  • Efficiently test ideas and designs: anything from back-of-the-envelope calculations to physical tests and multi-physics simulations
  • Design high-performance, reliable, easy-to-manufacture parts and assemblies, employing a variety of high-volume manufacturing processes
  • Create and review drawings and other part specifications
  • Manage bills of materials, cost and mass roll-ups, vendors and engineering releases
  • Define manufacturing processes and inspection methods
  • Collaborate directly with part manufacturers to support prototypes and production

Desired Skills/Experience

  • Mechanical Design
    • Extensive experience in 3D Modeling software (e.g. Onshape, NX, Solidworks)
    • Knowledge of how to make a PCBA Bed of Nails fixture.
    • Detailed knowledge of 2D Drawing creation and GD&T
    • Ability to analyze designs using Tolerance Analysis/Stackup, Statics/Load Path Analysis, Finite Element Analysis, Root Cause Analysis and Design Failure Modes and Effect Analysis
    • Familiarity with electronic test equipment and basic electromechanical troubleshooting
    • Experience with test fixtures, jigs, and various mechanical components for high cycle count.
    • Experience with fine pitch assemblies and construction.
    • Should be able to conduct strain gauge measurements and understand stress on PCBAs and incorporate proper design to avoid it.
    • Experience with PCBA management such as Mechanical Control Outline generation
    • Working knowledge of pneumatic cylinders and control methods
    • Working knowledge of Thermal Management techniques
    • Prototyping skills using 3D printing, machining, sheet metal bending, laser cutting, milling and general machine shop tools
    • Manage suppliers for all the parts which are required for our station construction.
  • Manufacturing Support
    • Experience communicating with component suppliers including Design for Manufacturing report review, First Article Inspection, and Part Production Approval Process
    • Ability to generate Work Instructions for electromechanical assemblies
    • Knowledge of Process Failure Modes and Effects Analysis
    • Create preventive maintenance documentation.
    • Extensive experience with Onsite Build Support at domestic and international contract manufacturing sites . Approximate 10-20% travel as and when required.
  • Communication
    • Ability to generate detailed design documentation
    • Drive a project from start to deployment involving other cross functional teams, vendors, technicians etc.
    • Ability to collaborate with other engineers (electrical engineers, automated test engineers, etc..)
    • Skilled at clear verbal and written communication including concise slide deck creation
    • Ability to give kind and direct feedback and receive feedback with an open mind

title: Corporate Development Manager
description:
Lunar Energy was founded to transition homes to 100% clean energy—making our electricity greener, our air cleaner and our energy more safe, secure and reliable for all. We’re a fast-growing, global company building the world’s best clean energy products to electrify all homes and connect communities to form clean, resilient virtual power plants.

We’re entering an exciting period of growth, creating new opportunities to scale our products, and expand into new markets. We’re looking for a Corporate Development Manager to be the analytical engine behind Lunar's growth strategy. You'll build and own the models that underpin some of our biggest decisions - how we sell our products, which markets we enter, and which companies we partner with or acquire.

This role is based at our London office (working in office ~3 days per week), with regular travel to the US, including our Mountain View HQ. You'll work directly with our CEO, President, and VP of Finance, and report to the Director of Finance & Corporate Development.

On a given day at Lunar, you'll likely…

  • Build and own complex financial models - commercial models, product unit economics, and project finance structures that fund our systems in customers' homes.
  • Evaluate financing structures for our products: understand cash flow waterfalls, customer contracts, residual value, tax equity , and how our partners make money.
  • Pull apart the unit economics of our hardware and software solutions, and tell us plainly which levers move margin and which don't.
  • Evaluate strategic partnerships (including potential acquisitions) end-to-end -market sizing, diligence, valuation, and the recommendation that follows.
  • Prepare board, investor, and lender materials, and present your own work to senior audiences.
  • Build simple internal tools and dashboards with AI so the whole team can answer recurring questions without waiting on a model.
  • Own Finance’s relationship with our Markets and Data Science teams, using our proprietary data to help make commercial decision.

What you'll bring

  • 3–6 years in an investment banking project finance team, management consulting, or a strategy or financial modelling role at an energy company.
  • Hands-on project finance experience: cash waterfalls, sensitivity analysis, cost of capital analysis, term sheets, and lender conversations.
  • Advanced Excel skills, with the ability to build robust models that other people can pick up and follow, and you're comfortable writing macros where they are additive.
  • Basic knowledge of more advanced modelling and analysis tools (Python or similar) particularly for complex analysis or problems that are less suited to Excel.
  • Confidence using AI to develop simple internal tools and dashboards, and curiosity about its wider application in the team.
  • Strong commercial analytics and the ability to take a complex business and get to the unit economics that actually explains it.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication, with the ability to translate complex analysis into clear recommendations and board-level material - and confidently explain and defend your assumptions to senior stakeholders
  • Willingness to travel frequently and flexibility to work some evening hours to collaborate with colleagues in California

Preferred skills & experience

  • Experience in residential or distributed energy, utilities, or energy infrastructure preferred.
  • Experience with leased or subscription-based products (financing structures, residuals, customer lifetime value) a plus
  • Exposure to corporate development activities such as market entry, strategic partnerships, fundraising, or mergers and acquisitions

Joining us gives you:-

  • Competitive Salary and stock options package
  • Private Medical Insurance scheme through BUPA (medical history disregarded);
  • A wellbeing and lifestyle benefits plan through Medicash
  • Enhanced Pension contributions: employer contributions matching 5%
  • A budget for work related training of £1,000 per financial year and an allowance of 4 training days
  • Cycle To Work scheme and Workplace Nursery benefit
  • Access to Spill - Mental Health Support platform
  • Enhanced Maternity + Paternity Pay
  • 25 days annual holiday entitlement + 8 Bank Holidays

Lunar Energy is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to attracting, developing and retaining diverse talent by supporting an inclusive workplace. Lunar recruits, hires, trains, promotes, compensates, and administers all personnel actions without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status or any other status protected by applicable law.

title: Electrical Engineer - ATE
description:
Electronics Engineers at Lunar are responsible for the full product development lifecycle of power electronics systems that recast day-to-day energy use in homes and on the go. We are looking for people with a passion to create a more sustainable future and the skills to make that vision a reality. An ideal candidate is enthusiastic and ready to collaborate with a dedicated, cross-functional team to create innovative, best-in-class products starting with home energy storage systems. Engineers at Lunar are hands-on comfortable with both simulation and real hardware, and able to carry product development from concept stage through high-volume production.

Lunar Energy was founded to transition homes to 100% clean energy—making our electricity greener, our air cleaner and our energy more safe, secure and reliable for all. We’re a fast-growing, global company building the world’s best clean energy products to electrify all homes and connect communities to form clean, resilient virtual power plants.

Any given day at Lunar you may...

  • Create the best possible products by contributing to product level features, design, and vision by leveraging your experience and creativity
  • Detail-level design of numerous tester interface boards ranging from IOT devices , power electronic systems, DC/DC converters,and inverters.
  • Bring up and testing of systems to validate functionality, optimize performance, and evaluate critical characteristics
  • Collaborate to create efficient test and validation mechanisms for the individual PCBAs as well as the complete system and support of the development of custom test cards and apparatus
  • Work with the ME cross functional team on a bed of nails fixture.
  • Work across functions such as mechanical, thermal, reliability, and firmware engineering to optimize the product
  • Start-to-finish ownership of the electrical aspect of the system from design through prototype, validation and manufacturing
  • Good debugging and troubleshooting skills down to the component level.

Desired Skills:

  • BS in Electrical Engineering with 3 years experience in power electronics design,
  • Experience with battery management systems ,inverters ,charge systems etc
  • Proficient with Altium Designer schematic capture and PCB layout. Experience working with PCB fab and assembly houses.
  • Strong lab skills with working knowledge of the tools and techniques for power conversion test and analysis (e.g., use of oscilloscopes, impedance analyzers, sources, and loads in an environment with both high voltages and currents, and high common-mode and differential-mode noise)
  • Working with high voltage, current, and power
  • Skilled at prototyping and rework - conduction and hot air soldering, paste application, flux application and cleaning, etc.
  • Familiarity with embedded control and application and programming of microcontrollers, PLDs and the like
  • Analog circuit design including op-amps, stability analysis, power supply design both linear and switching design.
  • Mixed-signal design with emphasis on noise analysis and grounding techniques.

Lunar employees also have the opportunity to become Lunar shareholders by getting equity in a fast-growing company and participating in our employee stock program.

  • Subsidized EV charging and pre-tax commuter benefits

title: Firmware Engineer Manager
description:
Embedded Firmware Manager

As an Embedded Firmware Manager, you'll play a central role in shaping the intelligence inside our hardware, writing the code that makes our devices perform reliably, efficiently, and safely in homes around the world. You'll work across the full embedded stack, from low-level bootloader to high-level application firmware, in a fast-moving team where your contributions have real and immediate impact.

Lunar Energy was founded to transition homes to 100% clean energy—making our electricity greener, our air cleaner and our energy more safe, secure and reliable for all. We’re a fast-growing, global company building the world’s best clean energy products to electrify all homes and connect communities to form clean, resilient virtual power plants.

On a given day at Lunar, you'll likely…

  • Develop firmware for our hardware devices, including optimisation on the edge.
  • Design, code, and test sub-systems that provide high-performance functionality on constrained hardware.
  • Write code across the full embedded stack — from bootloader to high-level application firmware. Develop platform firmware to support components like flash file systems, communication stacks, and build tool management.
  • Work in a RTOS environment, including porting and maintenance of the RTOS.
  • Build component firmware that integrates with other parts of the Lunar system.
  • Drive design discussions on system architecture to achieve the desired product functionality.
  • Collaborate with the team on design and development, including participating in code reviews.
  • Support system test, reliability, and manufacturing teams with special firmware features and debugging.
  • Review performance data from the Lunar system gathered at internal and external test sites.

Desired skills

  • 10+ years of experience developing and architecting software, with exposure to the full lifecycle from prototype to production.
  • Experience developing C in bare-metal systems and/or RTOS.
  • Experience implementing power electronics firmware control functionality.
  • Ability to integrate hardware and software to develop end-to-end solutions.
  • Comfortable working in a small, fast-moving team where individual initiative and contributions have a big impact.
  • Able to contribute in a multi-disciplinary team following modern software engineering practices (e.g. Git, continuous integration).

title: Power Electronics Engineer
description:
Lunar Energy was founded to transition homes to 100% clean energy—making our electricity greener, our air cleaner and our energy more safe, secure and reliable for all. We’re a fast-growing, global company building the world’s best clean energy products to electrify all homes and connect communities to form clean, resilient virtual power plants.

Responsibilities

  • Create the best possible products by contributing to product level features, design, and vision by leveraging your experience and creativity
  • Detailed design of power electronic systems from 10W – 10kW, DC/DC converters, offline isolated power supplies, and inverters including the selection of topology, semiconductors, magnetics design, schematic design and layout, EMC and design of various safety aspects
  • Collaborate to create efficient verification and validation test plans for the individual components as well as the complete system
  • Bring up and testing of systems to validate functionality, optimize performance, and evaluate critical characteristics

  • Detailed understanding of active and passive component losses in power conversion and the various means to reduce/mitigate those losses

  • Knowledge of sensor design to measure converter parameters in real time in a noisy environment
  • Familiarity with magnetics design and specification, applications of various core materials for both power and filtering, knowledge of winding structure and optimization, and insulation strategies
  • EMC design and optimization. Understanding of EMC theory applied to both PCB layout as well as filter designs
  • Ability to design schematics and conduct layout design or review as it applies to power conversion
  • Strong lab skills with working knowledge of the tools and techniques for power conversion test and analysis (e.g., use of oscilloscopes, impedance analyzers, sources, and loads in an environment with both high voltages and currents, and high common-mode and differential-mode noise)

Helpful Skills

  • Working with high voltage, current, and power

  • Familiarity with global safety and EMC certifications and building systems to pass the relevant codes
  • Previous work in the solar, energy storage, or EV/ EV Charging industries
  • Familiarity with embedded control and application and programming of microcontrollers
  • Understanding of mechanical and thermal considerations

title: Senior Reliability Engineer - Power Electronics
description:
Senior Reliability Engineer - Power Electronics

Reliability Engineers at Lunar Energy will be responsible for ensuring product reliability throughout the entire lifecycle of our revolutionary home energy products. This includes providing input during the design phases, developing test plans, and assessing on-going field performance. We are looking for people who are passionate about a more sustainable future and want to make that vision a reality. An ideal candidate is someone who is excited to collaborate with a diverse and dedicated team

Lunar Energy was founded to transition homes to 100% clean energy—making our electricity greener, our air cleaner and our energy more safe, secure and reliable for all. We’re a fast-growing, global company building the world’s best clean energy products to electrify all homes and connect communities to form clean, resilient virtual power plants.

On a given day at Lunar, you’ll likely…

  • Collaborate with mechanical and electrical engineers during hardware design to establish and refine component and system level reliability targets for our power electronics and battery systems.
  • Provide Design for Reliability (DfR) inputs during new product development.
  • Drive Design Failure Modes and Effects Analyses (DFMEA) for various systems to capture
    performance risks and implement appropriate mitigation activities.
  • Develop ALT Reliability Test Plans for components and subsystems using identified risks, reliability targets, and physics of failures methodology to demonstrate the required product reliability throughout its design life.
  • Track field reliability performance for various metrics like part replacements, customer complaints, fault codes. Identify opportunities for continuous product improvement and reliability growth. Collaborate with the finance team to provide insights into our warranty program.
  • Drive failure analysis of reliability test and/or field returns to determine root cause and drive product improvement through containment and corrective actions.

Desired Skills:

  • Degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Physics or
    Equivalent.
  • Proven track record of solving complex power electronics reliability failures
  • Working knowledge in theory of operation of common power converter topologies (inverter, buck boost converter…etc)
  • Strong grasp of PCBA-level failure physics (CTE mismatch, solder fatigue, contact resistance, insulation degradation)
  • Familiarity with failure modes in common power electronics components (electrolytic caps, relays, semiconductors, magnetics)
  • Working knowledge of failure analysis techniques such as optical microscopy, SEM, CSAM, X-ray, cross-sectioning and EDX - know which technique to recommend given a specific failure
  • Experience with accelerated life testing models and the governing equations, specifically for
    PCBAs, battery storage, and relevant mechanical structures.
  • Understanding of reliability statistics

title: Senior Supply Quality Engineer
description:
Delivering on that promise depends on the quality of every part that goes into our products. As our Sr. Supplier Quality Engineer, you make sure the components our suppliers ship meet our standards before they ever reach the line, so every home we power gets a product that lasts. This is a hands-on role spanning the full product lifecycle, from qualifying and developing suppliers through new product introduction and into sustaining quality once parts reach mass production.

Lunar Energy was founded to transition homes to 100% clean energy—making our electricity greener, our air cleaner and our energy more safe, secure and reliable for all.   • Review supplier-driven changes, assessing deviation requests, ECRs, and process or sourcing changes for risk, and approve them with the right requalification

  • Apply strong GD&T to drawing reviews and tolerance stack-ups, confirming parts are producible and inspectable before tooling is cut

  • 5–6 years of experience as a Supplier Quality Engineer, including sustaining operations and quality ownership from NPI through mass production
  • Direct experience with mechanical components (sheet metal, plastic injection molding, powder-coated metal), electrical components (wire harnesses, PCBA), and electromechanical assemblies
  • Strong GD&T knowledge and data analysis proficiency in JMP for capability, measurement-system, and reliability studies
  • A track record of independently owning supplier programs, from on-site qualification audits through mass production approval, using data to make the call

title: Technical Program Manager Intern, Hardware Engineering
description:
Technical Program Manager Intern, Hardware Engineering

Program Managers (PMs) at Lunar Energy lead complex engineering programs from initial concept through to volume manufacturing. As a Technical Program Manager (TPM) Intern on the Hardware Engineering team, you'll get hands-on experience supporting our products through bring-up testing, environmental and durability validation, failure analysis, and regulatory certification. You'll work closely with engineering, supply chain, manufacturing, and external partners, learning how a global team aligns around schedules, risk, and clear communication to ship reliable hardware. We're looking for someone who's excited about a more sustainable future and wants to see, firsthand, what it takes to bring that vision to market.
